policy: hierarchical taxonomy retaining normalized official fine labels; semantic coarse labels are assigned from label names only
design_constraints: No mapping rule is derived from test predictions or DeepSeek outputs.
The v1 sample population and report-level split assignments are preserved for comparability.
Fine labels remain traceable to the official audit-area strings.
Context may be reconstructed only from the same report, issuer reference, and official audit area.

level1_rules.label: Credit, Loans, Deposits and Insurance
level1_rules.pattern: insurance|reinsurance|premium|medical claims|unpaid.*claims|incurred but not reported|loss reserves|self-insurance

level1_rules.label: Revenue and Receivables
level1_rules.pattern: revenue|receivable|deferred revenue|contract liabilit|unbilled|fee and commission income|servicing fee income|sales discount|allowance for doubtful|other income|dividend income|contribution

level1_rules.label: Long-Lived and Intangible Assets
level1_rules.pattern: goodwill|intangible|long-lived|property, plant|plant, property|pp&e|oil and gas|mineral reserve|rental propert|real estate|capitalized software|internally developed software|asset retirement|reclamation|exploration and evaluation|mortgage servicing|assets held for sale|non-current asset|prepayment|lease|depreciation|amortization

level1_rules.label: Reporting, Controls, Estimates and Audit Procedures
Reporting, Controls, Estimates and Audit Procedures
level1_rules.pattern: journal|audit|control|financial reporting|misstatement|going concern|fraud|illegal act|planning|materiality|presentation|disclosure|segment|significant account|balance sheet|income statement|subsequent event|comparability|earnings per share|change management

context_reference_pattern: \b(these|those|such|aforementioned|above-mentioned)\s+(assets?|accounts?|transactions?|controls?|data|assumptions?|liabilities|procedures?)\b|\bthis control\b|\bthe procedures discussed above\b|\bas discussed above\b
